name: mlip-finetune-agent
description: Codex workflows for installing ELoRA with uv, fine-tuning MACE MLIP models, evaluating accuracy, and packaging releases.

interface.shortDescription: Install ELoRA with uv, fine-tune MLIPs, evaluate accuracy, and package releases.
interface.longDescription: ELoRA MLIP Fine-Tune Agent adds reusable Codex skills and scripts for uv-based ELoRA environment setup, dataset preparation, low-rank MACE/ELoRA fine-tuning, accuracy evaluation, and model release packaging.
defaultPrompt: Set up the uv ELoRA MLIP environment.
Prepare data for an ELoRA fine-tuning run.
Run ELoRA fine-tuning and package the model.
